04 / HOW THIS ATLAS IS MADE

Photographs → cameras → supported surfaces.

Images are screened for exact duplicates and grouped by recorded source families; grouping remains uncertain. COLMAP estimates cameras and shared structure; multi-view stereo estimates depth and surfaces. Separate components remain separate. A visual improvement is not an accuracy claim.
